correctness.rationale: On expectations of (1, eta_1, eta_2, eta_1 eta_2) the generator is block triangular with diagonal blocks 0, M=[[-a-h,h],[h,-b-h]], and -S with S=a+b. The characteristic polynomial follows by taking block determinants. The two eigenvalues of M are distinct by h>0 and strictly negative by positive definiteness of -M; det(M+SI)=ab-hS, so the only collision is at h=ab/S. On that locus v=(a,-b) is the colliding mode, while the other nonconstant linear mode has eigenvalue -2h distinct from -S. The coupling into the pair equation is (bq,ap)v=ab(q-p). At eigenvalue -S an eigenvector in the expectation representation must have zero constant coordinate; the middle coordinate must be a multiple of v, and is allowed if and only if this coupling vanishes. Therefore the eigenspace dimensions are exactly one or two as claimed. The first moments never inherit the Jordan prefactor, and integrating the pair equation against the projected fast deviation gives the stated coefficient. At a=b=2,h=1, the empty-start mean sum and difference equal s(1-e^(-2t)) and d/2(1-e^(-4t)). Inserting them gives forcing s^2(1-e^(-2t))-d^2/2(1-e^(-4t)) in C'+4C, yielding exactly the frozen formula. With only bath a active, the quadratic cannot vanish at -a (its value is -ah) or at zero (its value is ah); hence no one-bath defect. A single-site chain with positive refresh has two distinct eigenvalues.
residual_risks: The exact locus is for the stated positive rates and interior densities; the explicit nonvanishing empty-start coefficient is for the symmetric-rate example, not all resonant rates and initial conditions. Finite numerical checks are not used for the continuum claim.

value.rationale: This is the sharp minimum-size boundary for a phenomenon already seen on a larger endpoint-driven exclusion system. It gives a tunable necessary-and-sufficient defective locus and distinguishes a natural family of observables that misses the defect from one that detects it in relaxation from an elementary initial state. The small matrix is a means to that motivated boundary and observable distinction, not the contribution by itself.
residual_risks: No claim of arbitrary-system Jordan classification, or of universal visibility for any pair observable or initial law.
